text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn), Japan Cup, and 
Arima Kinen.

What was bestowed upon Mejiro McQueen for 
winning every single race was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Phew... That was the last of the 
celebratory gifts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for taking up space in the 
Trainer's room as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Knowing how everyone feels, I am 
truly grateful, however...
choice_data_list:
Congratulations again on achieving the 
Autumn Senior Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In addition to the Mejiro family's first 
Spring-Autumn Double Tenno Sho, achieving 
the Autumn Senior Triple Crown was only 
possible thanks to Trainer-san's support.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"My gratitude to you as well. Thank you so 
much—"
(Knock knock)
Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry. Were you in the middle of 
something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Satono-san. No, there is no issue at all. 
Did you need something?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I came to offer my congratulations to you 
both. Congratulations on winning the 
Autumn Senior Triple Crown!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... how polite of you. Thank you so 
much for going out of your way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, I have already received a 
celebratory gift from Miss Satono.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That biggest package—a golden crane game 
machine where you can play to win my 
plushies.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not nearly enough! That is why 
I came to see you in person.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san is truly wonderful. Watching 
her race the other day made me realize 
that all over again.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The person I admire becoming even more 
dazzling... ...Nothing could bring me 
greater joy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Aiming for that brilliance... I will 
pursue you with everything I have."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Fufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Um, McQueen-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. But to my ears, that hardly 
sounded like a celebration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—And I felt as though she was saying, "One 
day, I will overtake you."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, this is fine. That fighting spirit of 
yours is the greatest celebration I could 
ask for.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Pushing me toward even greater heights— I 
look forward to your challenge."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Yes! I'll definitely reach it, just you 
watch...!

Even after achieving such a great feat, 
she shows no signs of stopping. My heart 
raced at the thought of what new 
inspiration might await this stoic girl, 
when—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
By the way, the game I sent you... did you 
enjoy it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Since you know what's in it, I assumed 
you'd played it before, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
S-Someday! I swear I shall extract all of 
it!

And so, Mejiro McQueen became an Autumn 
Senior Triple Crown horse girl. What kind 
of great feat will she accomplish next... 
I can't wait to see!
